title: S3 ACC Platform Roles and Permission Boundaries

entries.name: Information Manager
entries.boundary: Overall CDE architecture, information security, archive write-lock enforcement, and technical validation of submission configuration. Platform capability does not itself grant authorization, acceptance, milestone, handover, contractual, or professional decision authority.

entries.name: Project BIM Manager
entries.boundary: Operational coordination governance, assigned coordination decision functions, model promotion, and /02 administration. Promotion capability or Project Administrator access does not itself grant authorize_for_formal_exchange, accept_for_declared_use, milestone_approval, or handover_acceptance authority.

entries.name: CDE Manager
entries.boundary: Technical provisioning, onboarding, group assignment, permission audits, platform configuration, and execution of authorized state transitions where assigned. Technical execution shall not be treated as the underlying decision authority.

entries.name: Project BIM Coordinator
entries.boundary: Coordination spaces, issue creation/assignment, clash verification, and coordination evidence within assigned scope. Workflow participation does not itself grant downstream authorization or acceptance authority.

entries.name: Discipline Lead
entries.boundary: Own-discipline WIP administration and controlled package sharing within assigned authority. Sharing capability shall remain traceable to the applicable approve_for_sharing decision where required.

entries.name: Model Author
entries.boundary: Own-discipline WIP authoring only; no decision authority is inferred from upload, edit, sync, or issue capability.

entries.name: Main Contractor Representative
entries.boundary: Published consumption plus submittal/RFI interfaces per BEP and applicable project instruments. Access to Published information does not itself establish acceptance or unrestricted reliance.

entries.name: Client Representative
entries.boundary: Published/transmittal review and record access per BEP and applicable project instruments. Viewer/reviewer access does not itself identify the person authorized to accept information for a declared use.

permission_authority_rule: Platform roles and permissions govern technical capability only. Decision authority shall be derived independently from the applicable decision type, purpose, scope, information state, governing authority basis, and authorized project role or party.
transition_execution_rule: Where a user or automation executes a CDE state transition, the transition shall remain traceable to any required upstream decision record. The transition actor and the decision authority may be different actors.

provenance.migration_note: Three distinct governed functions retain Project Administrator capability. Capability overlap is preserved and does not imply role equivalence or decision authority. ISO-IMP-005 curator reconciliation makes the platform-capability/decision-authority boundary explicit; programmatic separation of privileges remains under curator review.
